description: An advanced guide which might benefit you a lot 🎉 . 韩先凯的人生进阶指南 人生进阶指南 离谱的人生 人生进阶 AI学习 AI指南 韩先凯的AI学习指南 英语学习指南/英语学习教程/英语学习/学英语
one_liner: A free, continuously updated Chinese-language book (with an English version too) about lifelong learning in the AI era — English learning, doing real projects, and bouncing back from setbacks — written by one author sharing their personal journey.
buyer: This is a personal self-help book, not software — there isn't really a business buyer here, though a Chinese-language education platform might license or feature the content.
business_use_cases: A Chinese online education platform licenses excerpts as free lead-magnet content to attract self-improvement readers to paid courses.
The author sells a paid, expanded companion course or coaching program built on the ideas in the free guide.
A translator/publisher packages the English edition into a paid print or ebook release for a Western audience.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid companion course or 1:1 coaching program that goes deeper than the free guide.
Publish and sell a polished print/ebook edition through standard retail channels.

steal_this: This isn't really a weekend-buildable business idea — it's a personal writing project. The honest steal is the format: publish your own niche expertise as a free, continuously updated 'living book' on GitHub to build an audience, then monetize with a paid course later.
